mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.parent_id, p.perm_code, p.perm_name, p.type, p.path, p.icon, p.component FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON r.id = rp.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur2 JOIN sys_role r2 ON ur2.role_id = r2.id WHERE ur2.user_id = #{userId} AND r2.role_code = 'ROLE_ADMIN' );
